VALIDATION_FAILED.description: The request failed validation. Field-level codes are in `errors` (see validation_codes).

NOT_FOUND.description: The resource or route does not exist, or it is not yours.

METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED.description: The route exists but not with this HTTP method (see the Allow header).

UNAUTHENTICATED.description: No session, or it expired (including a refused refresh). Go to the sign-in form.

INVALID_CREDENTIALS.description: Login failed: wrong email or password. The same answer whether or not the account exists.

MFA_CHALLENGE_INVALID.description: The MFA challenge is missing, expired or already used. Go back to the sign-in form.

MFA_CODE_INVALID.description: Wrong TOTP or recovery code. Stay on the form; it counts toward the login throttle.

PASSWORD_INCORRECT.description: The current password is wrong (disable MFA, delete account). Stay on the form.

TOKEN_INVALID.description: The verify-email or reset token is missing, expired or already used. The reason is not given.

CSRF_FAILED.description: Missing or wrong X-CSRF-Token, or a bad Origin. Fetch GET /auth/csrf again and retry once.

EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED.description: The action needs a verified email address.

MFA_ALREADY_ENABLED.description: MFA enrollment was started while MFA is already active.

MFA_NOT_ENABLED.description: MFA was turned off while it is not active.

RATE_LIMITED.description: Too many requests. Wait for the Retry-After header (seconds) before trying again.

FILE_TOO_LARGE.description: The file is larger than the per-file limit (see GET /limits).

QUOTA_EXCEEDED.description: The workspace storage quota is full. Delete files or ask the owner to raise it.

INTERNAL_ERROR.description: Unexpected server error. Show the correlation_id so support can find it.

NOT_IMPLEMENTED.description: Contract stub: the endpoint is documented but not implemented yet.

MISSING.description: A required field (or the whole body) is missing.

EXTRA_FORBIDDEN.description: A field that the endpoint does not accept was sent.

JSON_INVALID.description: The body is not valid JSON.

MODEL_ATTRIBUTES_TYPE.description: The body must be a JSON object.

STRING_TOO_SHORT.description: The text is too short (minimum in params.min_length).

STRING_TOO_LONG.description: The text is too long (maximum in params.max_length).

STRING_PATTERN_MISMATCH.description: The text does not have the expected format (for example a 6-digit code).

LITERAL_ERROR.description: The value is not one of the allowed options (in params.expected).

UUID_PARSING.description: The id is not a valid UUID.

MFA_CODE_OR_RECOVERY_REQUIRED.description: Send exactly one of an authenticator code or a recovery code.

INT_FROM_FLOAT.description: A whole number is required, not a fraction.

GREATER_THAN.description: The number is too small (params.gt is the exclusive minimum).

GREATER_THAN_EQUAL.description: The number is too small (params.ge is the minimum).

LESS_THAN_EQUAL.description: The number is too large (params.le is the maximum).

INVALID.description: The value is invalid (fallback for a check without its own code).
